imageContext:
Image alt: This graphic shows a three dimensional line pyramid in the center. At the top of the pyramid is a box labeled “Company.” At each of the three bottom corners of the pyramid are boxes. Starting on the left and going counter-clockwise around the pyramid, the box is labeled “Social” and has three bullets that say “employee well-being,” “fair trade,” and “community stakeholder.” The next box is labeled “Economic” and has three bullets that say “revenue,” “growth,” and “cost.” The last box is labeled “Environmental” and has three bullets that say “land use,” “carbon footprint,” and “waste.”
